question: Is there an affine chain of three rings in which both contacts persist and the far contact binds the end rings at every lag from d + 1 on, so that the contact-network gate passes across time? Or do the arrival sets of affine chains always have gaps (the coordinator's stop condition for the process line)?

public_inputs.run: run.py in this folder, 16 worker processes.
public_inputs.family: Each ring its own linear rule among 0, 204, 240, 170, 60, 102, 90 and 150 (affine rules differ by constants, which change no verdict): 512 rule triples. Ring sizes mA and mC in 3..5, mB in 3..7, every contact position k in 1..mB-1: 180 size-position combinations. Each contact its own law by its linear part: the proposal parity, or a self-blind sum uX + uY with uX, uY in {x, y, x + y}: 10 laws, 100 pairs. In all 9,216,000 chains.
public_inputs.exactness: Every verdict is exact by ticket A's reduction (row sequences iterated until they repeat).

forbidden_inputs: Changing the family after seeing results
primary_observable: The number of chains in which both contacts persist; among them, how many compose at every lag from d + 1 on, and how many compose at both contacts; the rule triples and laws of the composing ones.
cheapest_meaningful_control: The twelve smallest persistently composing chains, if any, must give the same verdicts on their full state spaces. A search whose constructions fail this is not read.
first_executable_signal: The control, or the count of zero.
decision_or_followup_rule: H1, frozen: no chain of the family keeps both contacts persistent and composes from d + 1 on (gaps are forced). If H1 holds, the process line closes with forced gaps as its obstruction, as computed on the family, and a proof is sought. If H1 fails, the smallest constructions are verified on the full state space and reported as persistent native networks across time.
stop_rule: Stop when every chain of the family has its verdicts.
nonclaims: Exploratory and non-promotable: the declared family only.
Affine chains only: nonlinear chains are covered by earlier censuses.
feasibility_disclosure: Before freezing: ticket A's check ran its reduction on 1,200 random chains of a smaller family against their full state spaces; 12 of them composed at every lag from d + 1 on, and whether any also kept both contacts persistent was not computed. run.py --pilot timed 2,000 random chains of this family at 1.2 s and printed no verdicts.
